New Zealand Flag 3D Medallion STL – Kiwi Bird Relief Model for 3D Printing & CNC

This New Zealand Flag 3D Medallion STL is a high-detail relief model featuring a wavy New Zealand flag design combined with the iconic Kiwi bird silhouette. The medallion is created specifically for 3D printing, CNC carving, and relief engraving, making it ideal for souvenirs, decorative plaques, national symbols, and educational projects.

The circular composition emphasizes depth and clean geometry, while the flowing flag surface adds a dynamic, sculptural feel. The kiwi bird relief is carefully modeled to preserve recognizable contours and texture, ensuring excellent results across different manufacturing methods.

🛠️ Designed for 3D Printing & CNC Machining

This 3D relief STL model is fully optimized for:

  • FDM 3D printing
  • SLA / resin printing
  • CNC milling (wood, MDF, plastic, aluminum, brass)
  • Laser engraving (after depth adjustment)

The model is watertight, manifold, and scalable, allowing you to easily adjust diameter and thickness without losing detail.

🇳🇿 Perfect for New Zealand-Themed Projects

  • Decorative wall art and plaques
